content: Notifications: write every event to a notifications table per recipient (eager insert) regardless of transport delivery, so unread count and backlog are queryable independent of push/WebSocket; lazy read-time generation only for massive fan-out. Unread-count drift comes from caching count separately from rows, from client-side increments, and from partial mark-as-read; compute count from rows (indexed on user_id, read_at IS NULL) or maintain counter transactionally with the insert/read. Sources: dev.to marketplace notifications, medium fan-out articles.
